invariants.mechanical_limits_actuator_caps_and_sdk2: unchanged from frozen accepted diagnostic profiles

common_base_repair.terrain: clean external reconstruction of parent saved terrain geometry/proportions: 10x40, target stair platform1.5m, no imports of historical task/runner chains
common_base_repair.commands: direct body-frame; staircase banks traverse0.3/traverse0.7/stop_restart0.5 at equal episode weights, full20s traverse and12s zero phases
common_base_repair.axis_bank: both signs and command magnitudes retained; include dedicated small-axis programs alongside full v2 rehearsal, same sampler in both arms
common_base_repair.small_axis_program: 2s zero,8s +/-0.3,8s opposite0.3,12s zero; random first sign; alternate0.5 rehearsal; phase exposure must be measured
common_base_repair.reset: upright roll/pitch [-0.1,0.1], other declared randomization retained
common_base_repair.geometry_changes: only restore documented parent training distribution; no actuator/mass/armature/damping changes

required_evidence: initial and first unsafe state200Hz, including q/dq/torque/targets/contact loads and exact monotonic timestamps
actor observations57 and raw previous actions50Hz for selected episodes
per-term rewards, standard returns/advantages and cohort gradients from a separate no-optimizer diagnostic rollout
zero wheel target/estimated torque saturation streaks
parent and Adam exact before/after; unsafe overrides timeout
stage0_no_update_audit.gate: verify coverage, initial states and safety semantics before freezing coefficients; do not infer gradients from aggregate rewards

stage1_drive_safety_pilot.algorithm_other_fields: exact parent PPO configuration, no new runner hooks
stage1_drive_safety_pilot.variant: same base plus bounded actual-state predictive margin cost and zero-command physical wheel-target cost

predictive_margin_cost.definition: q_pred=q+T*dq; margin=min(q_pred-lower,upper-q_pred) for12legs; max_j clip(relu(1-margin/reserve),0,1)^2; accumulate over200Hz physics steps, use average in standard reward term
predictive_margin_cost.scope: soft reward only; actual hard limits and PD target acceptance unchanged

zero_wheel_target_cost.definition: on exact zero body command, sum_i (physical wheel dq_des_i/50)^2 for4wheels
zero_wheel_target_cost.scope: no action clipping; zero reference permits existing damping to brake; estimated motor torque remains separate diagnostic

stage1_drive_safety_pilot.causality: pilot tests the combined drive-safety reward package; it does not isolate the two costs from each other
stage1_drive_safety_pilot.evaluation: parent/control/variant,160 full v2 episodes each, isolated fresh processes, same complete case/reset order
stage1_drive_safety_pilot.gate: unsafe0, no paired covered-success losses or old successful-cell regressions, zero/transition gates unchanged, no worsening max wheel saturation or longest streak; positive state-margin/zero-wheel diagnostic required
stage1_drive_safety_pilot.coefficient_status: engineering hypotheses; verify range/sparsity on stage0 then freeze before PPO, no tuning on acceptance traces

stage2_small_axis_kernel_pilot.launch_condition: separate decision after stage1 passes retention/safety; otherwise do not run
stage2_small_axis_kernel_pilot.parent: only a checkpoint that passed stage1 gates; never the rejected9930 arms
stage2_small_axis_kernel_pilot.variant: only narrower relative-error kernel for pure small lateral/yaw commands
stage2_small_axis_kernel_pilot.kernel: for pure axis command magnitude0.25..0.5 use sigma=0.25*abs(command); lateral orthogonal x-error keeps sigma0.5; existing weights/max reward retained; all zero/vx/mixed/large-command kernels unchanged
stage2_small_axis_kernel_pilot.preserved: stage1 safety costs, sampler, robot/physics, PPO, ABI and every acceptance threshold
stage2_small_axis_kernel_pilot.evaluation: 480 complete matched v2 episodes, final checkpoints only
stage2_small_axis_kernel_pilot.gate: unsafe0, no paired losses or successful-cell regressions, at least2 new paired target-axis successes against parent and positive effect versus control, no wheel saturation/streak increase
